nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token contract instance held by the timelock.
Immutable address of the beneficiary that receives tokens after release time.
Immutable uint256 timestamp after which the tokens can be released.
Constructor setting token, beneficiary and release time, and enforcing releaseTime_ > block.timestamp.
Public view getter returning the held IERC20 token (_token).
Public view getter returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary).
Public view getter returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime).
Public function that checks block.timestamp >= releaseTime() and transfers the full token balance to the beneficiary.
Public view function returning the token balance currently held by the timelock contract.
Block timestamp used as an access gate in the constructor and in release(); miner-influenceable value.
External token transfer (IERC20.safeTransfer) to the beneficiary performed inside release(); performs an external call.
Constructor parameter assigning the ERC20 token contract being held.
Constructor parameter assigning the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter assigning the release timestamp.
Local uint256 amount holding the contract token balance computed in release() before transfer.
Local uint256 amount holding the contract token balance computed in getLockedAmount().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is stored into state variable _releaseTime.
Constructor validation depends on block.timestamp (releaseTime_ > block.timestamp), a timestamp dependency.
release() gate require(block.timestamp >= releaseTime()) depends on the miner-influenceable block timestamp.
release() reads the release time via releaseTime() for its require check.
release() calls token() to obtain the ERC20 instance used for balanceOf and transfer.
release() calls beneficiary() to determine the transfer recipient.
release() invokes the external transfer operation safeTransfer.
Local amount (token balance) is passed as the value parameter of safeTransfer.
token() result is used to query balanceOf(address(this)) that fills the local amount in release().
token() result is used in getLockedAmount() to query balanceOf(address(this)).
Local amount is the return value of getLockedAmount().
External token transfer callback can re-enter release() before completion; state consistency / reentrancy risk.
State variable _token is the target of the external safeTransfer call performed in release().

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ only exists to initialize _token and is fully absorbed by the constructor node.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ only exists to initialize _beneficiary and is fully absorbed by the constructor node.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ only exists to initialize _releaseTime and is fully absorbed by the constructor node.
Local amount in release() is computed solely to be passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
Local amount in getLockedAmount() is a temporary balance read returned directly by that function.
